name: The person's name.
headline: A target role or professional title.
contact: An email address, phone number, location, or profile link.
summary: A profile, objective, or executive summary.
section_heading: A heading such as Experience, Education, or Skills.
experience_header: A role, employer, location, or date range that identifies one experience.
experience_description: A bullet or sentence describing work in an experience.
education: A school, degree, course, or study date.
skills: A skill, tool, or skill list.
project: A project name or project description.
volunteer: A volunteer role, organization, or description.
language: A spoken language and optional proficiency.
publication: A paper, article, talk, or other publication.
reference: A reference person or their contact details.
other: Resume content that fits none of the defined kinds.
